Ruth has never been married or in a civil partnership and has never lived with another adult. Saul is Ruth's son and is a child within the meaning of section 142 of SSCBA 1992. Ruth is entitled to child benefit in respect of Saul of £26.05 per week for every week from the week beginning Monday 7 April 2025 to the week beginning Monday 30 March 2026, because Saul lives with her (section 143(1)(a) of SSCBA 1992). No election under section 13A of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 has effect for any of these amounts. Ruth's adjusted net income for 2025-26 is £70,000. Subject: Ruth. Tax year: 2025-26.

subject: Vince
facts: A tax year runs from 6 April to the following 5 April; tax year 2026-27 is 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027. Una and Vince have been married since 8 August 2008; they have lived together throughout and have never been separated. Ava is their daughter and is a child within the meaning of section 142 of SSCBA 1992; she has lived with both of them throughout. Una claimed child benefit for Ava in 2019. Nothing is stated about whether anyone is entitled to child benefit for Ava in 2026-27, for which weeks, how much, or whether any election under section 13A of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 has effect. Adjusted net income for 2026-27: Una £25,000; Vince £72,000. Subject: Vince. Tax year: 2026-27.
